newsitem.title: USA: TWA board ok's order of McDonnell MD83s.
newsitem.headline: TWA board ok's order of McDonnell MD83s.

text.p: Trans World Airlines Inc said Tuesday its board of directors approved acquisition of ten new McDonnell Douglas Corp MD83 aircraft.
McDonnell Douglas had announced the aircraft order at a recent Farnborough Air Show in the United Kingdom, TWA said in a statement.
TWA said the acquisition completes the exercise of options for the aircraft under an agreement originally announced in July 1996.

The planes will be leased under a long term arrangement and delivery of the ten aircraft is expected between June 1998 and April 1999, the airline said. Industry experts estimate the cost of each of these planes at about $35 million.

The board's action brings to 15 the total number of new McDonnell Douglas MD83s on firm order by TWA. The long term leasing arrangements provide for delivery of the first of these aircraft in July 1997. The airline currently operates a fleet of 52 MD80 series aircraft.

"These additional new MD83s not only help us with our expanded schedule, but are an integral part of our fleet modernization program," said TWA Senior Vice President-Operations Don Monteath, in a statement.
TWA said it will use the planes for its expanding schedule and to retire older aircraft.
